name: Amber Delta
description: Three camps a side along one broad channel. The Amber runs the whole map and only three ferry crossings span it, so a bank is a front line: the highway behind each bank links its three camps, and every attack has to buy a bridge first.
theme: Wide slow water, reed beds, and six armies drawn up along one river.
